description.en: A document that was delivered to or received from the First Nation describing the project detail, and proof of support or opposition to the project.
The act of notifying the First Nation about the project intent.
The First Nation being Notified of the Project Intent.

High-level details about the project in enough detail to provide stakeholders sufficient information to understand the scope and intent of the project. This information is intended to determine stakeholder support, specifically First Nation groups, before going in depth into the Archaeological Methodologies and processes for formal and more in-depth and structured First Nation Consultation processes.

instructions.en: Provide enough detail to allow all stakeholders to understand the intent, scope and impact of the project.
